register.name: IVC/CIE (Interregional Packaging Commission)
register.notes: Site fetched 2026-08-16: IVC/CIE is the government authority for packaging EPR; recognised schemes are Fost Plus (household, recognition 02.02.2024) and Valipac (industrial, 02.12.2021). Members declare via their scheme; non-members declare directly via forma.ivcie.be (a 'Dossierkost' file cost applies to direct declarants — amount at ivcie.be/dossierkost/, not yet fetched). The national page carried no explicit AR statement, but PPWR Art. 45 makes a local authorised representative mandatory for non-established (foreign) producers from 12.08.2026. NEW: IVC/CIE is rolling out a national producer register branded EPRIBEL (epribel.be), reported to start around 12.08.2026; as of 2026-08-16 the epribel.be site is still under construction and points back to ivcie.be — treat EPRIBEL as the emerging register, IVC/CIE the current channel.

pro.ecoModulation: Green Dot rates are per detailed material category: recyclable mono-materials cheap (clear PET bottles 0.360), hard-to-recycle formats punitive (other plastic films/PP films 2.210; composites, PVC, compostables, wood, obstructive packaging all 4.419 €/kg). New PPWR categories (beverage capsules 3.553–3.841, tea bags, fruit stickers) apply from 12.08.2026.

notes: Rates from the official Fost Plus 'Green Dot rates 2026 per material' PDF (fetched 2026-08-16, EUR/kg excl. VAT): glass 0.105, paper-cardboard 0.150, steel 0.186 (shown as 'metal'; alu ≥50µm 0.049, alu <50µm 0.451), beverage cartons 0.808 ('composite'), wood 4.419. Plastics range 0.360 (clear PET bottles) – 0.802 (rigid PE, shown as 'plastic') – 1.016 (rigid PP) – 1.080 (PE films) – 2.210 (PP/other films) – 4.419 (PVC, laminates, compostables) €/kg. Fost Plus membership/admin fees not in the tariff PDF — minAnnualFeeEur left null.
